slides.title: Leveraging Gen AI for Debugging & Building
slides.notes:
Today, we're going to talk about: 

how Generative AI can accelerate your debugging journey, especially when it comes to building static websites with HTML and CSS.

slides.body:
>>>> 
>>>> 
Have you ever encountereda problem with your website and felt stuck?
slides.notes:
Till now you all learnt some HTML,CSS concepts and solved so many coding problems right, So when you solving these coding problems having u ever faced like not getting correct output as you expected?
Even after you are trying for so many times, you will get errors or sometimes didn’t get the expected output .
Don’t worry - it happens to everyone! Whether you’re just learning to code or you’ve been doing it for years, sometimes things just don’t work.
But That was totally normal, Even the best coders and the experiences developers get stuck sometimes with the code.

slides.title: Introduction
slides.body:
Debugging
Debugging is the process of finding
and fixing the bugs in the Code
slides.notes:
If you getting an error or the output is not what you want, then what will you do?
You will change the code and test the code, until you get the correct result. Right?

This process is only called as debugging.

It is the process of finding the bugs and fixing the bugs in our code and Checking it is working or not.

slides.title: Debugging
slides.notes:
Debugging the code is very important skill for every developer.
Even Some companies conducts debug competitions, where people try to find and fix bugs in their apps or websites.
Why do they do this?
Because, when people find bugs and fix them, the app or website becomes better and works perfectly. So, these companies reward people who find bugs because their goal is to make sure there are no bugs in the final product!
That’s why !! Whether you're building something simple or complex application, or Whether you are a beginner or an experienced Developer,
 Debugging is a very important skill for any developer to make sure their website works fine without any bugs.

slides.notes:
For Debugging, there is a process to follow for better results

Here it is the process

First - Understand the code
Then - Identify what is the causing the issue
Then finally - resolve that issue accordingly 

Always focus on the code first — understand the root cause of the bug, and then work on fixing it.
This is crucial because when you're working on a project as part of a team, you'll often deal with code written by other developers. Or you might be maintaining an old application developed years ago – in such cases, Gen AI won’t have enough context about that 1000 lines of code.
That’s why it’s important to you only first understand the existing code thoroughly — only then will you be able to debug and resolve issues effectively.

slides.title: GenAI for presenting websites in Interviews
slides.notes:
Until now, you've been building websites based on mockup designs or rough sketches of your ideas. But in interviews, you need to show your projects to highlight your skills.
To make your projects unique and stand out, try to present more unique designs. 
One way to do this is by creating different versions of an existing design. This means you take the same basic design and change things like colors, layout, or features.
Making different versions of your design shows that you are creative, which will impress interviewers and help you stand out. It shows you can come up with new ideas and solve problems in different ways.

Start by Debugging Manually: Before turning to GenAI, attempt to debug the issue yourself. This builds your debugging skills and understanding of the problem.
Use GenAI for Suggestions: If you are stuck, use GenAI to identify potential fixes. However, always try to understand why the solution works.
Understand the Solution: Don’t just copy and paste the fixes suggested by GenAI. Take time to understand the reasoning behind the solution and apply it to future problems.
Learn from AI Responses: Use AI suggestions as learning tools. If GenAI suggests a change, look into why that change works and how it applies to your code.
Practice Regularly: Debugging is a skill that improves with practice. Use GenAI as a tool to help you solve problems faster, but continue practicing and learning the manual debugging process.
